About the game

MapBop is developed by Oyri Games. The game includes advertising, in-app purchases, and subscriptions. This page provides information about using the game and store purchases. Development screenshots and features may differ from the final release.

App Store license

For an App Store-distributed version, Apple’s standard end-user license agreement applies unless a different custom license is specified in the store listing. Check the applicable license on the store page where you download the game. Apple Standard EULA ↗

Purchases and virtual content

Review the offered product’s price, scope, and any renewal terms on the store screen before confirming payment. Payments are processed by the relevant store. Restoration depends on the same store account and product type; consumable in-game content may not be restorable.

Subscription terms

Subscription benefits, price, currency, billing period, and any trial are displayed in the purchase screen. If you choose an auto-renewing plan, you are charged at the stated intervals until renewal is canceled under the store’s terms. If a free or discounted trial is offered, the subsequent price and renewal terms are shown before confirmation. This page does not announce a fixed price, billing period, or trial offer.

Manage or cancel a subscription

iPhone or iPad: Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Android: Google Play → profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions. Sign in with the account used to subscribe. Use the official help pages for current steps and regional terms.

Apple — cancel a subscription
Google Play — manage subscriptions

Refunds and subscription management

Refunds are reviewed by the store where the purchase was made. Manage subscriptions through the store account used to subscribe; deleting the app or requesting data deletion alone does not cancel a subscription. Apple purchase support ↗
